params.body:
Shane, with the screen in front of him: "ik vind niet even sectie even actionable". Three things were wrong, and they are three different mistakes.

## The screen contradicted itself

Top of the page: "20 wagens werden de voorbije 7 dagen door een partner geweigerd". Four lines lower, over the same week: "5 weigeringen in 7 dagen".

The verdict counted `sum(ok = 0)`. The partner line counted `count($partners['failures'])`, and that query ends on `limit(5)`, so it could never say more than five however many were refused. The total is now its own value (`partners['refused']`) and the list stays capped, because the list is there to read and not to count.

A screen that contradicts itself is not half believed. That costs more than the number: the whole attention layer leans on the assumption that what sits under it measures the same thing.

## An amber that nobody would ever act on

The photo mill called out eleven photos "in verwerking sinds meer dan een uur", every morning. On production those eleven carry the flag since February through August, and all eleven are platform copies whose file never arrived. Nobody is waiting for them.

The same flag means two things, so the hour is split. A row from today is someone's tile still turning: that asks for attention. A row from months ago is a dead row: that asks for cleanup, and the fold now says so with `stocklist:photos-without-file` instead of repeating the number. Only the first one reaches the verdict at the top.

## A line that described its own fold

"Koppelingen — per dienst, nu" tells you what is inside, so you had to open it to learn whether anything was wrong. It now reads "alle 13 koppelingen antwoorden", or names the ones that do not. It reads the same cache the panel underneath reads (`IntegrationChecks::last`, filled by `stocklist:smoke`), so it costs no call to any third party.

## And the reasons are grouped

Twenty times the same 403 from the same partner used to be the last five raw log lines. It is now one line per partner, status and cause, with how many times, how many vehicles and when the last one was: "nederlandmobiel · 20 keer, 17 wagens · HTTP 403 · antwoord is geen XML · laatst 21/09 18:58". That says at once whether it is still happening and whom to call.

## Verified

`EveryLineOfWerkingCarriesAVerdictTest` pins all four: the partner number counts seven refusals where the list holds five, the reasons group per cause, an old flag is cleanup and not attention while a fresh one is, and the integrations line names who fails.

Full suite locally: 2.109 tests, 12.269 assertions, with only the two known `ListPageHeadersTest` cases failing, which fail the same way without this change because those tables are empty in my local database. `phpstan` green over the whole project, `pint` green on the added file.

Fixes bevinding werking-sprak-zichzelf-tegen.
params.title: Every line on Werking carries a verdict, and the verdict is true
